customerJourneyStories.name: Dawn Engagement and Chapter Lead: from need to sustained outcome
customerJourneyStories.summary: Illustrative scenario, not an observed customer account.

stages.narrative: A new client commitment or integration of specialist teams changes demand for delivery capacity.
The lead identifies available chapter expertise and shared-services support through the internal capability catalog.
The lead compares team assignments against client obligations, workload, technical fit and knowledge-transfer needs.
A bounded engagement tests the proposed ownership and shared-asset arrangements.
Accepted work scales only after capacity and client support continuity are demonstrated.
Retrospectives update maintained patterns and backup coverage while client-specific knowledge remains isolated.
